paragraphs: The scrupulous people of Jerusalem. Mentioned in [Sanhedrin 23a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.23a.16) and [30a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.30a.22).[^1][^2]

notes.text: At 23a the baraita gives their custom of knowing who would sign, sit in judgment or dine with them.
At 30a Rabbi Nechemyah cites their procedure for hearing litigants and witnesses. The designation refers to a group.
